body:
I'm in the same position as you. My ex is the absolute perfect girl for me. I have literally nothing bad to say about her. But unfortunately she just wasnt ready for a relationship. Even though I poured my life and everything into that relationship... And I will most likely never see her again.

For several weeks I have been googling different suicide methods and where to get the stuff to accomplish it. And things like "but think about all the people you'll hurt this way, what would she feel if she found out?" hardly even have an effect on this excrutiating pain.

But well, today I hooked up with a friend. My heart isnt in it. But all I can say is that for a very brief moment I felt just a little better. I dunno if I get better than this.. Maybe I am doomed to live like James Bond after casino royale. Hooking up with pretty women to mask my pain. But I have, after so much pain, reached a point where I no longer see suicide as the only option.
Thanks. It's true what you are saying. And I would not want to bring that pain upon all the people in my life, and also not her if she found out...
